title: Creature Shelter: loop over every creature, feed when hunger >= 5

panels.caption: Initial state: three creatures (Mossy 8, Pip 5, Tuft 2) sit in a fixed list, but no loop has run yet, so the log is just a prompt. The rule box already states the branch the condition will choose: hunger >= 5 feeds, otherwise leave alone, with exactly 5 on the fed side.

Running the loop visits each creature in order and applies the same body: the condition hunger >= 5. Mossy (8) is fed as an ordinary case. Pip sits at exactly 5, the boundary, and the >= comparison puts it on the fed branch, so only Pip's line carries the boundary note. Tuft (2) takes the else branch and is left alone. Three creatures, three visits.

Branch exercise: lowering Pip from 5 to 4 moves it just below the boundary. The same loop visits the same three creatures, but the condition now chooses the else branch for Pip, so it is left alone and the fed count drops to 1.

Raising Tuft to exactly 5 shows the boundary case on a different creature: hunger >= 5 is true at 5, so Tuft is fed and receives the boundary annotation while Mossy at 8 does not. The condition is applied identically on every visit; only the input decides the branch.
Emptying the shelter gives the loop an empty list. The body runs zero times, so no creature line appears and no condition is ever evaluated; the footer reports 0 visits.
Restoring the creatures refills the list with the original hungers 8, 5, 2 and reruns the loop: three visits again, Mossy fed, Pip fed at the exact boundary of 5, Tuft left alone.

supportingMachinery: Array of creature objects built from three number inputs via document.getElementById
Classic indexed for loop over the creature array with a per-visit if/else branch
A single boolean flag (shelterEmpty) that swaps in an empty list for the zero-visit case
addEventListener for click, input, and change events on data-testid elements
A <pre> element updated through textContent with lines joined by newline characters
CSS grid two-column layout with fixed 1100x760 body and overflow hidden
Creation source generated by claude-fable-5-1 (requested fable, effort medium); this does not retrain the model
Claude Code CLI invoked in print mode with no tools, no hooks, no MCP and a strict JSON schema to generate the creation source
Node publisher (src/workshop/publisher.ts) validating inputs, source, and verifier output host-side without executing model JavaScript
Inline browser rendering: a single self-contained HTML document with inline CSS/JS and a forced restrictive Content-Security-Policy
Playwright verification inside an isolated, offline, read-only, unprivileged Docker container that screenshots cumulative tested state
Hosting requirement: demo.html must be served from a separate sandbox origin by the parent application

verification.description: The actual demo was executed in an offline container. Every declared click and input change matched observed output; these images were captured from that run.
